acceptanceResults: A1: Public adopter and N-1 acceptance harnesses remove their validated run_root on success and ordinary failure while preserving acceptance truth and cleanup receipt.
A2: A forced cleanup failure records cleanupState failed and exits non-zero without rewriting releasePublished truth or hiding the failure reason.
A3: The N-1 harness success path does not reference an unset exit status and returns zero when all acceptance steps and cleanup pass.
A4: Test wrappers cover syntax, success/failure cleanup metadata, no leaked roots, and the N-1 success exit-status regression without downloading a Runtime from source.
A5: Isolation manifests include files directories symlinks metadata and digests for HOME XDG_CONFIG_HOME TMPDIR and CARGO_HOME, with allowed-write policy explicit.
A6: Three-language release documentation remains consistent with cleanup and isolation receipt behavior.
summary: Verification evidence passed; human-visible benefit remains explicitly unknown unless declared by the Work Item owner.
